import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

rows = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1"], text=True
).splitlines()
parsed = []
skipped_deleted = []
for row in rows:
    code = row[:2]
    path = row[3:]
    if " -> " in path:
        path = path.split(" -> ", 1)[1]
    if not path.endswith(".json"):
        continue
    candidate = pathlib.Path(path)
    if "D" in code and not candidate.exists():
        skipped_deleted.append(path)
        continue
    with candidate.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.load(handle)
    parsed.append(path)
print(json.dumps({
    "parsed_count": len(parsed),
    "parsed_paths": sorted(parsed),
    "intentionally_deleted_json": sorted(skipped_deleted),
}, sort_keys=True))
